turns.replyText:
Message from you:
What's your return and refund policy?
Message from Flo 🩸:
Our return and refund policy depends on what you purchased, but here are the key rules: 
Most eligible items can be returned or exchanged within 30 days of delivery (see product-specific conditions below).
Sale items: Items discounted 30% and below are eligible for size exchange or store credit. Items discounted above 30% are final sale (no refunds, store credits, or exchanges).
Final sale (always ineligible for refund/store credit/exchange): Items received for free, Gifts with Purchase, Digital Gift Cards, Washbags, Band Extenders, MNTD Mens Socks.
Items purchased from third-party sellers are not returnable with us.
Product-specific notes 
Knix Apparel (Leggings, Sweats, T-Shirts, Socks and Sleepwear) and Swim: return/exchange within 30 days of delivery as long as the original tags and sanitary strip (swim bottoms and one pieces) are attached.
MNTD Tees: return/exchange within 30 days of delivery regardless if they have been worn or are still in their original packaging. If after 30 days you’re still not happy with the fit, you can initiate a return for a refund, store credit, or exchange.
MNTD Socks and Sale items are final sale.
Holiday return window (past period) 
Eligible items purchased online or in stores between November 18, 2025 and December 31, 2025, may be returned through January 31, 2026. All other purchases fall under the 30 day returns policy.
